text:
sam (mktg): FYI — Silverpine interview locked for Thu 11am PT. Need a one-line quote + logo OK by Tue COB so we can publish launch post + open webinar regs next Wed. Recording will be uploaded.

leo (content): I'll draft two headline options: metric and qualitative. Provisional: "Redwood halved our P95 latency while reducing per-request cost." Can switch numbers post-attestation.

tanya (legal): If we publish specific metrics we need written attestation from Silverpine. Also request their logo usage terms. If attestation isn't available, we'll soften language (e.g., "significant") to keep schedule.

andre (sales): I'll ask the AE to request attestation and logo permission today. Also check if Silverpine is fine with co-branded webinar slides.

morgan (ops): Registration routing plan: add hidden field `source=case_webinar` and `priority_demo` boolean. If priority_demo==true -> assign AE-Priority for 48h else -> 14-day nurture. I'll implement Tue AM.

nina (demand): Promo plan: blog, email to benchmark list, two LinkedIn posts. Publish at 9am PT when regs open. Also ask Silverpine for a 30s video quote clip if possible.

transcript-bot: Transcript/link will be posted after recording.

sam (mktg): Action list: 1) Andre: attestation/logo request (today) 2) Leo: two copy variants (Mon noon) 3) Tanya: legal review + logo terms (Tue COB) 4) Morgan: HubSpot fields + routing (Tue AM) 5) Nina: promo locked once assets approved. Tag @tanya if legal issues. :thumbsup:
